annotations.annotation_text: Page 582 opens Book 3, Chapter 4 ("The Bedroom Scene") during the Age of Men (closing) phase. This passage continues HCE and ALP in bed, the children's cries, attempted sexual intercourse, domestic reality intruding on the cosmic dream, featuring HCE, ALP, Shem, Shaun, Issy. The nocturnal dream-narrative layers Dublin topography, world mythology, and linguistic alchemy into polysemic prose.
